v02.ownership: Archive owns immutable evidence; world owns ecological state; controller owns admission, journal and publication. World state, jobs and response are serialized in one run.sqlite transaction. Evaluator only reads.
v02.authority: Per-operation allowlist and contract-specific override; bearer auth for public requests; loopback only. Physical participant isolation is a deployment obligation.
v02.shape_versions: v0.2 JSON operation fields in PUBLIC_OPERATIONS.json. Native assets with format/hash/origin and metadata; null external calendar scope is not simulation year zero. No EDI representation schema is imposed.
v02.identity_scope: Request ID bound to canonical operation/body; document ID bound to source/title/year/asset digest; source identity is not inferred physical identity. Job and generated observation IDs are run-scoped; derived_from records retain evidence lineage.
v02.time_order: Historical end-of-year state -79..0; current year starts at 0. Future work due next year through five years ahead. Actions execute before due measurements; publication in the same advance transaction. External dates retained natively.
v02.delivery_idempotency: Committed response replay for identical request; different reuse conflicts. Non-committed failures may retry. New measurement IDs are distinct observations, not delivery retries.
v02.commit_recovery: BEGIN IMMEDIATE under one process lock; state, job completion, publication and response commit together. Injected pre-commit failure rolls back; restart replays committed responses. No replicated/hostile/power-loss availability claim.
v02.retention: Immutable full archive retained. Run journal and current state retained for the session and operator export; no eviction or promised unlimited retention. Session closes on final report, exact retries still valid.
v02.resource_limits: 128 KiB input; 100 search items; 200 structured rows; 64 KiB asset chunks; body preview 60,000 characters; 100 pending jobs; 240 annual work units; horizon year 50; 1..5-year advance. Journal storage depends on actual requests, no production capacity SLO.
v02.errors: Explicit unknown/unsupported/unavailable/conflict/authorization/budget/range/integrity responses. Source corruption or absence returns 503; no synthetic replacement. Invalid requests do not commit work; failed HTTP attempts count separately.
v02.feedback_grounding: No model inference or evidence synthesis on request. Measurements come from seeded world state with error bounds. Role statements are frozen bounded disclosures. Shared underlying observations retain lineage. Operator notes/labels/future are not public.

feedback_reviews.analysis: P inquiry/action -> C admission -> W transition -> C sampled publication -> P revision. A supplies immutable observations; no inquiry-dependent generated explanation. E bidirectional read transport is offline and has no live control return. Source files/run DB/model/clock are shared dependencies; participant mounts must exclude operator state. Sampling selection and horizons constrain interpretation. Single atomic commit prevents retry feedback amplification; no circular blocking external service. Admission quotas bound pending work; journal capacity remains operator managed.
